title: The National Lotteries (Amendment) Act, 2004
text:
Legal Supplement Part Ato the “Trinidad and Tobago Gazette’’, Vol. 43,
No. 44, 18th March, 2004
Second Session Eighth Parliament Republic of
Trinidad and Tobago
REPUBLIC OF TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO
Act No. 11 of 2004
[L.S.]
AN ACT to amend the National Lotteries Act,
Chap. 21:04 to alter the definition of “financial year”
[Assented to 12th March, 2004]
ENACTED by the Parliament of Trinidad and Tobago as Enactment
follows:—
l. This Act may be cited as the National Short title
Lotteries (Amendment) Act, 2004.

232 No. 11 National Lotteries (Amendment) 2004
2. Section 2 of the National Lotteries Act is amended
Section 2 amended
Chap. 21:04 by deleting the definition of “financial year” and
substituting the following definition:
“ “financial year” means the period of twelve
months ending the 30th day of September
in any year;”.
Passed in the House of Representatives this 7th day
of November, 2003.
D. DOLLY
Acting Clerk of the House
Passed in the Senate this 9th day of March, 2004.
N. JAGGASSAR
Acting Clerk of the Senate
PRINTED BY THE GOVERNMENT PRINTER, PORT-OF-SPAIN
REPUBLIC OF TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO—2004
